text.p: Tele-Communications Inc's cable unit, TCI Communications Inc., on Tuesday said systems with more than seven million customers would comprise its major metropolitan markets group, or Group A, under a new structure announced recently.
Systems serving about 6 million customers are included in Group B, the company said.
TCI has created the new group structure to focus on different needs of the communities it serves, and to create technology solutions tailored specifically to meet those needs.
The major metropolitan markets within Group A are preparing to offer new services on advanced cable systems.
Group B includes cable systems where TCI's digital television product, ALL TV, is to be deployed.

Group C will consist of markets where TCI will offer integrated delivery of its core cable product, ALL TV, its digital television, People Link by TCI, a wireline telephone service and Home, an Internet service.
